Container.Name: PrerollsMax
Container.Overview: Prerolls Max plays intro videos (prerolls) before movies and episodes on Plex, Jellyfin and Emby: schedules, holidays, playlists, rules, community intros, movie trailers and a video maker. It replaces NeXroll: point /data at NeXroll's appdata folder and it copies nexroll.db on first start (NeXroll's file isn't changed), or import a NeXroll backup in Settings, Moving from NeXroll. Stop NeXroll first, or give Prerolls Max another host port to keep both.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: The web page. Use another host port (e.g. 9494) to run next to NeXroll.

Config.Name: App data
Config.Description: Settings, database, logs and thumbnails. NeXroll's appdata folder works too: its database is copied on first start.

Config.Name: Intro videos
Config.Description: Your intro videos. Your media server must see this folder too (set Folder mapping in Settings if its path differs).

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: So schedules start at the right time
